A math problem has a right answer.
An AI can try a million times and learn from every miss.
But a painting? There's no answer key.
Score it an 8, and it still doesn't know what to fix.
So it piles on every pretty trick it knows.
Nothing wrong with it. Nothing you'd watch twice.
AI makes making things cheap.
What's scarce now is knowing what to keep, and what to throw away.
